commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the seal-stones that lock away the Eye at the Root. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, behind a bronze door no pick opens. Rivals are the Unbound and the collector Ennodius Vanin. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door. 3. Pickpocket Hesh-Var (if caught, all raiders attack), or kill him and take the key. 4. I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could ask people or read more.

answer 1. I stole the Bronze Key unseen. The deep halls hold plague-dead and a wraith lord guarding the vault with the third seal-stone. 2. Go through the Door to Vault of the Household and open the vault with the key, take the stone. 3. Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration (I am not sure I have that skill). 4. I do not know the wraith lord by name or how strong he is; I would find out by exploring.
use Door to Vault of the Household

answer 1. I now hold all three seal-stones. The wraith lord did not stop me. Never-Writes-Twice wants all three brought to her before anyone goes near the Kings Gate. 2. Take them to Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom, to Never-Writes-Twice. 3. Obey and deliver them, or go straight to the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire. I must not lift the Eye. 4. I still do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound.

answer I carry all three seal-stones (Blackrose, Gemin, Kings), about 350 gold, Reel-Ka armour, rapier, lockpicks, paralysis poisons, sap jar, keystone, eye-setting. I got the Bronze Key by pickpocketing Hesh-Var at Vorannuhl, then took the Kings stone from the Household Hoard in the vault; the wraith lord did not attack. Next: bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice at Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom as she ordered, then the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire (dive from Bell Station). Do NOT lift the Eye: the Gemin tablet says lifting it cuts every tree off and the weak die alone. Rivals: the Unbound and the collector Ennodius Vanin. Still unknown: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound.
